title: Start hook warns when the cloud snapshot is behind main
why: A stale snapshot makes every new lane print old warnings and run old hooks.
note: Warn once on a cloud startup when the snapshot's settings.json still holds a startup entry other than the refresh hook, and name the fix (edit the environment, save the Setup script). hooks/ lag alone does no harm (decision cloud-start-hooks-run-fresh), so it does not warn. Rulings: coordinator 2026-11-06 14:42 CST (trigger on the harm, no commit marker). PR #1363 (stale snapshot warning), round 3 passed, held by batch runner 8; step done when it merges. Measured before: 31 lanes printed the old EXECPATH line.
